evidence: Labeled Tests and refactors unit tests and test helpers in src/test/transaction_tests.cpp to isolate test cases.
rationale: Refactors `test_IsStandard` into isolated test cases and replaces mutable static globals with an explicit policy struct to prevent state leakage. While this provides real value for test isolation and cleanliness as part of #36692, test code cleanliness ranks behind signal, coverage, and speed in test infrastructure, making it reasonably deferrable.
